title: There is a Mallworld story in the latest episode (episode 700) of Jim Harold’s Campfire podcast
content: A man calls in to talk through his daughter’s story. He talks about a dream she had, in a shopping mall and she meets a deceased relative. I won’t spoil it so you can listen for yourselves if you want. It’s just a short story and take it as you will. But it is interesting that the specific dream was set in the shopping mall.
